description.value:
You and your bonded familiar gain Proficiency in the Survival skill and both of you can use your spellcasting ability score in place of the usual ability score for this skill.

Additionally, you gain one of the following benefits based on your chosen Wild Domain:

Wild Domain Feature
Wild DomainEffect
DunesYou are acclimatized to extreme heat and your Speed increases by 5 feet.
MarshesYou and your bonded familiar cannot be Surprised unless you are Incapacitated.
PeaksYou gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
TundrasYou are acclimatized to extreme cold and you ignore 3 caused by ice and snow, magical or otherwise.
WavesYou gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. If you already have a Swim Speed, you add 30 feet to it.
WealdsYou and your bonded familiar gain Proficiency in the Stealth skill and both of you can use your spellcasting ability score in place of the usual ability score for this skill.
